name: USPS Mail Analyzer
summary: Analyze USPS Informed Delivery digest emails: parse mailpiece scans, vision-classify, apply rules, write memory, send notifications

tools.name: usps_process_digest
tools.description: Process a USPS Informed Delivery digest folder and classify each mailpiece.

folder.description: Path to directory containing body.html and image files.

workspace_agent.description: Agent workspace that owns USPS rules, config, analysis history, and workflow state.

memory_agent.description: Agent workspace that owns long-term mail memory markdown.

analysis.description: Optional pre-computed analysis. Array of objects, one per image (in filename sort order), each with: sender, addressee, description, type, importance, mail_class, address_method.

date.description: Override delivery date (YYYY-MM-DD). Auto-detected if omitted.

dry_run.description: If true, skip sending notifications (print instead).

vision_backend.description: 'auto' (configured agent, default), 'provided' (use analysis arg), 'skip' (parsing only, no vision).

message_id.description: Outlook Graph API message ID of this digest. Used for state tracking and deduplication across runs.

vision_agent.description: Agent that performs USPS scan-image vision analysis. Required when vision_backend is auto.

tools.name: usps_lookup
tools.description: Search saved USPS mail history by GUID, date, or text.

workspace_agent.description: Agent workspace that owns USPS rules, config, analysis history, and workflow state.

guid.description: Partial GUID to match (first 8 chars is typical).

date.description: Date or partial date to match (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM).

search.description: Text to search for in any field.

tools.name: usps_update_rule
tools.description: Add, remove, or test USPS mail classification rules.

workspace_agent.description: Agent workspace that owns USPS rules, config, analysis history, and workflow state.

conditions.description: Rule conditions (for 'add'). Keys like sender_contains, addressee_contains, description_not_contains, etc.

comment_match.description: Remove rule whose comment contains this text (for 'remove').

mailpiece.description: Mailpiece info dict to test against rules (for 'test').

tools.name: usps_rules
tools.description: List USPS classification rules or test a sample mailpiece.

workspace_agent.description: Agent workspace that owns USPS rules, config, analysis history, and workflow state.

test_mailpiece.description: Optional mailpiece to test. Provide sender, addressee, etc. Returns which rule matches and the resulting importance.

tools.name: usps_stats
tools.description: Show summary statistics for processed USPS mail.

workspace_agent.description: Agent workspace that owns USPS rules, config, analysis history, and workflow state.

tools.name: usps_status
tools.description: Show the current USPS mail workflow state.

workspace_agent.description: Agent workspace that owns USPS rules, config, analysis history, and workflow state.
